title: Three-Sign Cancellation Hypernumber Systems and Associator Curvature
summary: We introduce and study a three-sign cancellation hypernumber system $H$ which extends the real field by adjoining a third sign $Λ$. The underlying set is $H=\{0\}\cup\{+,-,Λ\}\times\mathbb{R}_{>0}$, with a single-valued multiplication and a hyperaddition $\boxplus$ designed to encode cancellation phenomena between positive and negative reals. The classical real line embeds as a genuine subfield $\mathbb{R}_{\mathrm{cl}}\subset H$, and all field operations agree with the usual ones on $\mathbb{R}$.
